_comment: Hand-curated descriptions for icons that fail the canonical search. Each description mentions: (1) the shape, (2) the category (app/logo/token/glyph), and (3) any distinguishing detail (chirality, fill state, count). These are seed descriptions used to validate the cross-modal hybrid wiring. Once verified, the rule-based generator produces the rest.
lock: closed padlock with the shackle engaged, indicating a locked state
lockOpen: open padlock with the shackle disengaged, indicating an unlocked state
key: single horizontal key with teeth, isolated glyph used for credentials
tokenKey: key inside a colored rounded square chrome, an EuiToken indicating a key field type
apmApp: Kibana application icon for APM, a magnifying glass overlaid on a horizontal chart line, square chart-style framing
logoLogstash: Elastic Logstash product logo, three vertical pipes joining downward into a single output, brand-colored
fleetApp: Kibana application icon for Fleet, a sailboat or ship silhouette inside a square app frame
logoGCP: Google Cloud Platform logo, four overlapping rotated squares forming a hexagonal cloud silhouette in Google brand colors
plusInCircle: plus sign centered inside an outlined circle, addition glyph
plusInCircleFilled: plus sign centered inside a solid filled circle, addition glyph
plusInSquare: plus sign centered inside an outlined square with rounded corners, addition glyph
minusInCircle: minus sign centered inside an outlined circle, subtraction glyph
minusInCircleFilled: minus sign centered inside a solid filled circle, subtraction glyph
minusInSquare: minus sign centered inside an outlined square with rounded corners, subtraction glyph
